professional_summary: Software Engineer specializing in Frontend and Full Stack Development with experience in building scalable web and mobile applications, including real-time systems and AI-driven tools. Proficient in ReactJS, NextJS, TypeScript, NodeJS, NestJS, Flutter, and AWS. Experienced in collaborating with international teams, particularly in Norway, and working in both full-time and remote roles within startups and tech companies.

responsibilities: Revamped and modernized all customer-facing pages of the website using Next.js and Tailwind CSS, significantly improving performance and user experience.
Built Hotel Booking Module, handling real-time availability, pricing, and booking confirmation workflows.
Engineered the Admin Dashboard for internal staff to oversee operations, manage hotels, handle customer bookings, and monitor system health.
Implemented rate-limiting and throttling in Django backend, reducing server overload incidents by 60% and enhancing platform security.
Identified and resolved 30+ production-level bugs in both frontend and backend stacks, increasing system reliability and uptime to 99.9%.
achievements: Increased system reliability and uptime to 99.9%

responsibilities: Built an AI-driven Chrome and Figma plugin tool to automatically detect difference between Figma designs and developed web apps, ensuring pixel-perfect accuracy.
Orchestrated deployment pipelines using Github Actions for continuous integration and delivery, reducing update times.
Integrated Hugging Face LLMs and Google Gemini API to analyze UI discrepancies and suggest accurate fixes.
Engineered a real-time visual diff engine using canvas rendering and DOM snapshots to identify mismatches with over 95% detection accuracy.
achievements: Achieved over 95% detection accuracy in design-to-code consistency

responsibilities: Built the complete architecture for Aeme (EdTech) using Next.js, TypeScript, SCSS and AWS services to achieve performance and security benchmarks.
Contributed to creating the company’s own component library using Storybook to decrease development team effort by 50%.
Developed the Investment Pitch Creation feature in the Flutter mobile app for Pitch40 using GetX.
Built the founder onboarding and investor matching web & mobile application for Pitch40 using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams across Norway and India.
achievements: Decreased development team effort by 50% via component library
Contributed to successful fundraising of 600M NOK for Pitch40

cloud_platforms: AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, SES, Cognito, Cloudfront, Lambda, API Gateway)

Sincerely,
Praveen Kumar Singh
